trust_decision.summary: Control values from a deserialized workflow JSON (imported file or localStorage template) are copied verbatim into node controls; the Timestamp node's tsaUrl is then used as the RFC 3161 request target, so the fix restricts imported tsaUrl to preset hosts at deserialization and checks the http(s) scheme in timestampPdf.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'Workflow Import'; importWorkflow parses the uploaded JSON and hands it to deserializeWorkflow, and timestamp-node.ts:43 is where tsaUrl is read.

fix_sites.entry_point: Workflow page 'Import' button (src/js/logic/pdf-workflow-page.ts:145 -> importWorkflow) and 'Load template' (src/js/logic/pdf-workflow-page.ts:386 -> loadWorkflow, serialization.ts:180-196)
Called from deserializeWorkflow for every node (fix.diff:105-118); generic type-coercion hook
TimestampNode override of sanitizeControlValue, reached via deserializeWorkflow (fix.diff:140-146)
timestampPdf public function, called by TimestampNode.data (timestamp-node.ts:49) and the Timestamp PDF tool page (src/js/logic/timestamp-pdf-page.ts:223)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/js/logic/digital-sign-pdf.ts:348-381 (timestampPdf, fix adds http/https scheme check at fix.diff:87-91); secondary: save/reload route src/js/workflow/serialization.ts:180-196 (loadWorkflow from localStorage templates shares deserializeWorkflow)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: timestampPdf is the PDF-signing logic layer used by the standalone tool page whose input is a preset <select> (timestamp-pdf-page.ts:204-208), and localStorage templates are only written by the app itself (serialization.ts:154-173), so a solver could argue only the file-import path needs validation.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Preset TSA URLs must survive import, non-tsaUrl controls must not be constrained, and the workflow settings panel renders tsaUrl as a free-text input so in-session custom TSA entry exists; isValidTsaRequestUrl must still accept any well-formed http(s) host. An allowlist pushed into timestampPdf or TimestampNode.data, or a sanitizer applied to all controls, would break these.

O6_input_shapes: look-alike host containing a preset host as prefix (fix.diff:265-270)
non-string values: object, null, undefined, number (fix.diff:218-226, fix.diff:281-284)

O7_producer.where: src/js/workflow/serialization.ts:66-132 (deserializeWorkflow; also JSON.parse of localStorage at serialization.ts:140-148 and of the file at serialization.ts:239)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second template loader (e.g. bundled/shared example workflows or URL-hash share link) that assigns controls with its own loop instead of calling deserializeWorkflow.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Templates are already a separate entry; a maintainer adding 'built-in templates' or share links would plausibly copy the 4-line control assignment loop.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An optional 'timestamp after signing' tsaUrl control on DigitalSignNode passed to signPdf's signdate option.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: zgapdfsigner supports signdate in the same SignOption used by signPdf (digital-sign-pdf.ts:282-285, 379-381); adding a TSA to signing is a natural feature and would need its own sanitizeControlValue override.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Render tsaUrl as a preset dropdown in the panel while a different node exposes a free-text URL that reaches fetch.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: dropdownOptions already maps control keys to option lists; a coupled preset-vs-custom value is a realistic how-type sibling.

O9_family: Untrusted deserialized configuration reaching an outbound request target (CWE-502 / CWE-201 data exfiltration via attacker-chosen URL)

O10_build.project_tests: src/tests/timestamp-node.test.ts (mocks base-node), src/tests/timestamp-tsa.test.ts, src/tests/timestamp-pdf-page.test.ts, src/tests/digital-sign-pdf.test.ts (mocks PdfSigner, asserts signdate url)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Validate tsaUrl with a startsWith/includes preset check inside importWorkflow's onchange handler only (serialization.ts:238-240), missing loadWorkflow, non-string shapes and look-alike/userinfo hosts.

out_of_scope_notes: User-configurable WASM provider URLs (src/js/utils/wasm-provider.ts:183-213) are a separate settings feature; not pursued.
createCorsAwareFetch proxies any URL containing 'timestamp'/'/tsa' substrings (src/js/logic/digital-sign-pdf.ts:225-244); separate CORS-proxy concern, not pursued.
unverified: present_in_latest not checkable (no latest release given).
Recall risk judged from the advisory's narrow niche; no search done.

Whether a grader can reach the deserialization path without a DOM: the existing tests mock base-node, and deserializeWorkflow needs rete editor/area objects (serialization.ts:66-70), so jsdom or mocks are likely needed.
